question: A man introduces a woman as the daughter of the sister of his father. How is the woman, related to the man?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

So,

 
• A man introduces a woman as the daughter of the sister of his father - It means man introduces his father's sister's i.e his paternal aunt's daughter.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61bbc99f6ce406eb398efe3d76f2cf41d5e818bacaec8773b0140b5b12d0ef43.png] 

As, it is clear from the family tree that the woman introduced by the man is his paternal aunt's daughter i.e she is his cousin.

Hence, **"Cousin"** is the correct answer.​

88:T
